input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The issue is that the ExportButton component sets the busy state to true before the exportReport function starts and only sets it back to false on a successful export in the then() handler. If the exportReport promise rejects (for example, due to a server error), the catch is missing, and thus busy remains true, keeping the button disabled (greyed out). 

Fix would be to handle promise rejection by adding a .catch() that sets busy back to false and shows an error toast.
